lead: A green conformance case can be pinning the bug you are about to fix.
body: A case that reaches for a construct incidentally (`$maybe["gone"] ?? …` as a way to spell a read) freezes whatever that construct did when it was written, and its `--EXPECT--` block is only as authoritative as that session. When a case goes red under a fix, check its expectation against PHP (`php -r '…'`) before adjusting either side.
